description: pitolabs default for every repository (base-repo-standard). Repo-specific managers and groups live in the repo's renovate.json; automerge is the separate :automerge preset.

packageRules.description: PyPI releases wait three days, like npm (security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm in config:best-practices)

Same tag, new digest of an action or a release asset = upstream re-pushed it, as attackers did with trivy-action's tags in March 2026: a human investigates first. Docker images are rebuilt under the same tag for base-image patches as a matter of course, so their digest updates are routine and :automerge takes them

Digest updates and lockfile refreshes carry no release timestamp at the branch stage: with the default timestamp-required, renovate/stability-days stays pending for ever and nothing merges (renovatebot/renovate#45236). The digest's age is still checked at lookup (the tag's push time); a lockfile refresh cannot be aged at all
No age gate on the lockfile refresh: Renovate has no timestamps for what it pulls in, so any age leaves the PR pending (renovatebot/renovate discussion #47061)
